name: Scale-locked residual sampling pipeline (low-res planner, nested noise, x0 lock)
plain: Samples a low-resolution copy first (target_megapixels, default 1 MP) with plain CFG and records its x0 at every step. It builds the high-res noise as the nearest-upsampled planner noise plus a whitened high-frequency part (weight nested_noise_strength) from a second seed derived by XOR, renormalized per channel. It then samples at full size with a guider whose x0 is pulled toward the matched planner x0 in a coarse and a mid band while keeping its own finest band, with scheduled strengths and an optional low-band warp. Anchors are matched by nearest planner sigma and never step backwards; the sampler is checked against a 'safe' list and only warned about by default. The detailer-hook node runs the same path inside Impact detailers, using the crop mask (hook internals only partly read).
math:
Planner: x0ₖ^plan, σₖ^plan from CFG sampling of the downscaled latent (seed s).
Noise: n = std_norm(up_nearest(n_low) + h·std_norm(ε − up_nearest(down(ε)))), ε ~ N(0,I) with seed s ⊕ 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15, h = nested_noise_strength.
Each step: k = argmin |σₖ^plan − σ| (never below the last k); A = resize(x0ₖ^plan). LP_c(z) = up_bilinear(area_down(z, c)); D = guider x0.
D′ = (D − LP_mid(D)) + lerp(LP_low(D), LP_low(A), a_low) + lerp(LP_mid(D) − LP_low(D), LP_mid(A) − LP_low(A), a_mid); with a mask: D + M(D′ − D).
a_low = clamp(lock_strength·sched(start→end, progress), 0, 1); a_mid = a_low·mid_band_strength (linked mode).

props.hook: guider (predict_noise wrapper) plus its own sampling run
props.extra_model_calls: one whole low-res sampling run before the high-res run
props.params: steps=24, cfg=1.0, target_megapixels=1.0, nested_noise_strength=0.35, lock_strength=0.85, lock_strength_start=0.95, lock_strength_end=0.25, coarse_cutoff=0.33, mid_band_cutoff=0.6, mid_band_strength=0.35, manifold_enabled=false
